tasks.title: Contract 2.4.0 defines and validates runtime settings, channels and resend
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, all Behavior, Checks, Tool facts and Completion evidence; Required behavior R1; Decisions 9, 12, 14-16; Contract fields; Counterexamples; Security impact; Performance impact (contract); Acceptance evidence 1 and 7. Ship the schemas, inferred types, never-throw same-object validators, exact constants/export inventory, sole scopes and audit enums as one coherent 2.4.0 release with committed dist. Include complete service-state shapes and never/null invariants, file-channel views without routing, report counts/totals and resend admission/final states. Export and document the aggregate definition-byte limit; its enforcement belongs to api. Keep WIRE_VERSION unchanged. Use independent literal key/export lists, including the 20 color keys from status 8b6d431.

acceptance.command: bun test test/runtime-settings.test.ts test/notify-channels.test.ts test/resend.test.ts test/tokens.test.ts test/audit.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail (focused coverage is not the full-suite gate); validators preserve object identity and do not throw. Literal failures cover duplicate componentOrder, 61-character name, #12, 4pt, null setting, PULSE_API_TOKEN reference, ../x, literal url, database file channel, Ops id, status+read and status with location. File views accept file. Reports reject 201 failed entries, 201 file channels and 101 shadowed ids; never with non-null report is rejected; queued result is rejected. Notify metadata and older scope lists pass; notify-channel.create/check audit-kind mismatch fails.

exit 0; lint, build, typecheck, type fixtures, full tests and the 80% coverage gate pass; smoke tests compare the exact Contract fields export inventory and all four new dist modules to a fresh build.

acceptance.command: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
acceptance.expected: exit 0 after the rebuilt dist is committed; no dist difference remains.

PR records check/dist output, new tests failing on ebf6bbc for missing exports then passing, applicable Security impact checklist, and the contract A/B command with full SHAs using the api harness --b-ref contract=<contract branch> from Performance impact (read/record its shared finding). Include contract test_cpu_s and build_cpu_s rows against budgets 9.0 s and 6.4 s; state rounds and any budget failure. No new runtime package.
